    include
)

    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-target>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-target>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:arm64-apple-macos>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:arm64-apple-macos>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-isysroot>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-isysroot>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-DNDEBUG>
)
set_target_properties(condensate_analysis PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_features(condensate_analysis PRIVATE cxx_std_26)
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")

    set_property(TARGET task_components PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()
target_link_libraries(task_components PRIVATE
    core
    condensate_analysis
    meson_analysis
    statistics
    iodata
)
target_link_directories(task_components PRIVATE
    build/macosx/arm64/release
)
target_link_options(task_components PRIVATE
    -target
    arm64-apple-macos
    -isysroot
    /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk
    -lz
)
# private sourcefiles from sourcebatch c++.build for target task_components
target_sources(task_components PRIVATE 
    build/meson_task.cpp
    build/meson_singlesrc_task.cpp
    build/meson_multisrc_task.cpp
    build/condensate_task.cpp
)

# target
add_executable(test_condensate "")
set_target_properties(test_condensate PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "test_condensate")
set_target_properties(test_condensate PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin")
add_dependencies(test_condensate iodata statistics condensate_analysis meson_analysis core)
target_include_directories(test_condensate PRIVATE
    include
)
target_compile_options(test_condensate PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-target>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-target>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:arm64-apple-macos>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:arm64-apple-macos>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-isysroot>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-isysroot>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-DNDEBUG>
)
set_target_properties(test_condensate PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_features(test_condensate PRIVATE cxx_std_26)
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(test_condensate PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-O2>)
else()
    target_compile_options(test_condensate PRIVATE -O3)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
else()
    target_compile_options(test_condensate PRIVATE -fvisibility=hidden)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    set_property(TARGET test_condensate PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()
target_link_libraries(test_condensate PRIVATE
    core
    meson_analysis
    condensate_analysis
    statistics
    iodata
)
target_link_directories(test_condensate PRIVATE
    build/macosx/arm64/release
)
target_link_options(test_condensate PRIVATE
    -target
    arm64-apple-macos
    -isysroot
    /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk
    -lz
)
# private sourcefiles from sourcebatch c++.build for target test_condensate
target_sources(test_condensate PRIVATE 
    tests/test_condensate_pipeline.cpp
)
